topic_ko: AI가 제약 R&D 비용을 낮춰 소외 인구의 질환 연구를 확장한다
_note: 요약(논설문) FULL set. 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase. grammar/vocab의 밑줄·blank_target은 해당 passage 문장에 글자 그대로 존재. summary options (A)/(B)는 manifest 정답과 일치.

passage: In the pharmaceutical industry, algorithms are being employed to find treatments and drugs for rare diseases that to date haven't received much attention.
The hard truth has always been that pharma devotes more research and development resources to diseases that affect the rich.

The definition of rare has too often been associated with poor ― that is, even if a disease is quite prevalent in a population that cannot afford to pay for it (for example, people living in the developing world), the disease has been neglected compared to First World illnesses.

By lowering the cost of data collection, mining, and analysis in drug development and clinical trials, AI can help offset imbalances in the pharmaceutical industry that direct attention to diseases that "pay," whether because the disease is more common or because it is prevalent among demographics that can pay more.

We see the democratizing power of AI to broaden the attention of the medical and research communities to find cures to traditionally neglected health issues and among traditionally neglected populations.
summary.summary_template: By lowering the cost of pharmaceutical research and development, AI can help reduce the imbalance in investment that has led to the __(A)__ of less profitable diseases, thereby broadening the focus of medical research to include __(B)__ populations.
summary.explanation_ko: (A) 수익성 낮은 질환이 '경시(disregard)'되어 온 불균형 — 본문 'neglected', 'hasn't received much attention'과 직결. (B) 전통적으로 의료 서비스를 받지 못한 '혜택받지 못한(underserved)' 인구 — 본문 'traditionally neglected populations'와 일치. ⑤ disregard / underserved가 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: ①prevention(예방)은 본문 키워드가 아님. ②spread(확산)/general(일반)은 확장 방향 오류. ③overlook은 명사로 쓰이지 않음. ④ignorance(무지)는 의도적 경시가 아닌 뉘앙스이고, wealthy(부유한)는 방향 반대.

passage: Pharmaceutical companies have traditionally allocated more R&D investment to diseases affecting wealthy populations.
The term 'rare disease' has become informally synonymous with diseases of the poor, even when those diseases are widespread in developing nations.
A condition can be highly common in a low-income community yet receive little research attention simply because those affected cannot pay for treatment.
AI-powered data tools dramatically reduce the expense of drug discovery and clinical testing, making previously uneconomical research feasible.
This cost reduction enables the industry to investigate diseases that have long been overlooked because they offer low profit potential.
By equalizing the economics of pharmaceutical research, AI extends the reach of medicine to groups that have historically been underserved.
The medical and research communities gain the capacity to seek cures in populations and disease areas that were once considered commercially unviable.
In this way, AI serves as a democratizing force that broadens the scope of global health research.
choices: the challenges of conducting clinical trials in developing countries
how AI reduces pharmaceutical research costs and expands focus to neglected diseases
why rare diseases are more dangerous than common ones
the ethical issues of charging high prices for life-saving drugs
how wealthy nations dominate the global pharmaceutical market
theme.explanation_ko: AI가 제약 연구 비용을 낮춰 그동안 외면받아 온 희귀·빈곤층 질환에 의료 관심을 넓힌다는 내용. ②가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ①개발도상국 임상 시험의 어려움, ③희귀 질환의 위험성, ④약가 윤리, ⑤선진국 시장 지배는 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: Pharmaceutical research has long followed the money, concentrating resources on conditions that affect the paying public.
Diseases common in low-income or developing-world populations have been branded 'rare' largely because the people they affect cannot fund their own treatments.
Artificial intelligence changes the economics of drug development by slashing the costs of data collection, analysis, and clinical testing.
When R&D becomes cheaper, commercially overlooked diseases become viable research targets.
The industry's historic bias toward profitable conditions begins to weaken as AI lowers the financial barrier to studying all disease types.
Populations that once lacked access to medical innovation can now be brought into the scope of global research.
AI's ability to make research cost-effective across all demographics transforms it into a powerful equalizer in global health.
The promise of AI lies in redirecting medicine's gaze toward those who need it most.
choices: AI: Closing the Profit Gap in Pharmaceutical Research
Why Drug Companies Prefer Treating the Wealthy
The High Cost of Developing Medicines for Rare Diseases
How Data Science Is Replacing Clinical Trials
Rare Diseases: A Challenge Only Wealthier Nations Can Solve
title.explanation_ko: AI가 제약 연구의 비용을 낮춰 수익 격차를 줄이고 소외된 질환으로 관심을 확장한다는 핵심을 가장 잘 압축한 ①이 제목으로 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ②는 기존 문제 진단이지 AI의 해결책을 포함하지 않음. ③④⑤는 본문의 핵심 메시지(AI의 민주화 역량)를 담지 못함.

passage: In the pharmaceutical industry, algorithms are being employed to find treatments and drugs for rare diseases that to date haven't received much attention.
The hard truth has always been that pharma devotes more research and development resources to diseases that affect the rich.

The definition of rare has too often been associated with poor ― that is, even if a disease is quite prevalent in a population that cannot afford to pay for it, the disease has been neglected compared to First World illnesses.

By lowering the cost of data collection, mining, and analysis in drug development and clinical trials, AI can help offset imbalances in the pharmaceutical industry that directing attention to diseases that pay.

We see the democratizing power of AI to broaden the attention of the medical and research communities to find cures to traditionally neglected health issues and among traditionally neglected populations.
grammar.explanation_ko: ④ 'imbalances in the pharmaceutical industry that directing attention...' — that은 주격 관계대명사로 뒤에 동사원형(또는 정동사)이 와야 한다. 동명사 directing이 아니라 직접 정동사 direct가 되어야 올바른 관계절이 된다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①being employed(현재 진행 수동태) 적절. ②that affect(관계대명사절) 적절. ③even if(양보절) 적절. ⑤to broaden(형용사적 부정사) 적절.

passage: In the pharmaceutical industry, algorithms are being utilized to find treatments and drugs for rare diseases that to date haven't received much attention.
The hard truth has always been that pharma devotes more research and development resources to diseases that affect the rich.

The definition of rare has too often been associated with poor ― that is, even if a disease is quite prevalent in a population that cannot afford to pay for it, the disease has been neglected compared to First World illnesses.

By lowering the cost of data collection, mining, and analysis in drug development and clinical trials, AI can help aggravate imbalances in the pharmaceutical industry that direct attention to diseases that pay.

We see the democratizing power of AI to broaden the attention of the medical and research communities to find cures to traditionally neglected health issues and among traditionally neglected populations.
vocab.explanation_ko: ④ 글 전체가 AI가 제약 불균형을 '상쇄(offset)한다'는 내용인데, aggravate(악화시키다)는 글의 핵심 주장과 정반대이다 → offset으로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①utilized(활용되다), ②devotes(쏟아 붓다), ③prevalent(만연한), ⑤broaden(넓히다)은 모두 문맥상 적절하다.

passage: Pharmaceutical companies have historically focused their R&D resources on conditions that are profitable.
Diseases affecting low-income populations, even if widespread, have been labeled rare and largely overlooked.
The economic logic is simple: research is funded where the market can pay.
AI reduces the cost of data-intensive processes in drug development and clinical trials.
This makes it possible to investigate conditions that were previously uneconomical to study.
As a result, AI can help correct the imbalances that have kept attention away from diseases of the poor.
In general, the lower the cost of research, the wider the range of diseases that can be addressed.
AI thus becomes a tool to expand medical attention to underserved populations and neglected health issues.
blank.blank_target: the lower the cost of research
choices: the lower the cost of research
the more clinical trials are required
blank.explanation_ko: AI가 비용을 낮춰 연구 가능한 질환의 범위가 넓어진다는 문맥. '연구 비용이 낮을수록(the lower the cost of research) 더 다양한 질환을 다룰 수 있다'는 the 비교급 구문이 적합하다.
blank.distractor_ko: ②이익률이 높을수록, ③임상 시험이 더 필요할수록, ④환자 등록이 줄수록, ⑤규제가 강화될수록은 모두 본문 맥락과 어긋난다.

order.given: In the pharmaceutical industry, algorithms are being employed to find treatments and drugs for rare diseases that to date haven't received much attention. The hard truth has always been that pharma devotes more research and development resources to diseases that affect the rich.

blocks.A: We see the democratizing power of AI to broaden the attention of the medical and research communities to find cures to traditionally neglected health issues and among traditionally neglected populations.
blocks.B: By lowering the cost of data collection, mining, and analysis in drug development and clinical trials, AI can help offset imbalances in the pharmaceutical industry that direct attention to diseases that pay, whether because the disease is more common or because it is prevalent among demographics that can pay more.
blocks.C: The definition of rare has too often been associated with poor ― that is, even if a disease is quite prevalent in a population that cannot afford to pay for it, the disease has been neglected compared to First World illnesses.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글(제약 R&D의 부유층 편중)에 이어, (C)에서 '희귀=가난'이라는 정의 왜곡을 구체화하고, (B)에서 AI의 비용 절감이 불균형을 상쇄한다는 해결책을 제시하며, (A)에서 AI의 민주화 역량으로 결론 짓는다. (C)-(B)-(A) = ⑤.
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 '그 정의의 왜곡'은 주어진 글의 문제를 심화하므로 먼저 오고, (B)의 AI 해법 뒤에 (A) 결론이 와야 논리 흐름이 완성된다.

insert.insert_sentence: By lowering the cost of data collection, mining, and analysis in drug development and clinical trials, AI can help offset imbalances in the pharmaceutical industry that direct attention to diseases that "pay."

passage_marked.text: The hard truth has always been that pharma devotes more research and development resources to diseases that affect the rich.
The definition of rare has too often been associated with poor, meaning diseases in populations that cannot pay for treatment have been neglected.
This neglect persists because pharmaceutical research is largely driven by market forces.
When research becomes more cost-efficient, commercially overlooked diseases become viable targets for study.
We see the democratizing power of AI to broaden the attention of the medical and research communities to find cures to traditionally neglected health issues.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장(AI가 비용을 낮춰 불균형을 상쇄한다)은 ③의 '시장 논리에 의한 방치' 문제에 대한 직접적 해법이며, ③ 이후에 삽입되어야 ④의 'When research becomes cost-efficient...'가 그 결과로 자연스럽게 이어진다. 따라서 ③이 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: ①②에서는 아직 문제 제기 중이라 AI 해법이 오기에 너무 이르다. ④ 뒤에 넣으면 '비용 절감 결과' 문장 이후에 '비용 절감 원인'이 오는 역순이 되어 논리가 어긋난다. ⑤에서는 이미 결론이 나온 후라 삽입이 부자연스럽다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 우리는 의료 및 연구 공동체의 관심을 넓히는 AI의 민주화 역량을 본다.
writing.answer: We see the democratizing power of AI to broaden the attention of the medical and research communities.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어 We + 동사 see + 목적어 the democratizing power of AI + 형용사적 부정사 to broaden the attention of the medical and research communities.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 제약 산업에서 알고리즘은 지금까지 많은 주목을 받지 못한 희귀 질환의 치료법을 찾는 데 활용되고 있다.
writing.answer: Algorithms are being employed to find treatments for rare diseases that to date haven't received much attention.
writing.explanation_ko: 현재 진행 수동태 are being employed + 목적의 부정사 to find + 주격 관계절 that to date haven't received much attention.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 데이터 수집 비용을 낮춤으로써, AI는 제약 산업의 불균형을 상쇄하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있다.
writing.answer: By lowering the cost of data collection, AI can help offset imbalances in the pharmaceutical industry.
writing.explanation_ko: 수단의 By + 동명사(lowering), help + 동사원형(offset), 목적어 imbalances in the pharmaceutical industry.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: The definition of rare has too often been associated with poor ― that is, even if a disease is quite prevalent in a population that cannot afford to pay for it (for example, people living in the developing world), the disease has been neglected compared to First World illnesses.
writing.answer: '희귀'의 정의는 너무 자주 '가난'과 연결되어 왔는데 ― 즉, 비용을 감당할 수 없는 인구(예를 들어 개발도상국 사람들)에서 어떤 질환이 상당히 만연하더라도, 그 질환은 선진국 질환에 비해 외면당해 왔다.
writing.explanation_ko: has been associated with(~와 연결되어 왔다, 현재완료 수동), even if(비록 ~해도, 양보), prevalent(만연한), cannot afford to pay(비용을 감당할 수 없는), has been neglected(외면당해 왔다), First World illnesses(선진국 질환).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: AI can help reduce the (A)___________ in pharmaceutical research investment that has resulted in the neglect of diseases affecting (B)___________ populations.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) AI가 상쇄하는 대상은 제약 연구 투자의 "불균형(imbalance)". (B) 전통적으로 "방치된(neglected)" 인구 집단.

writing.question: 다음 글의 주제를 <조건>에 맞게 한 문장의 영어로 쓰시오.
writing.ko_prompt: AI가 제약 연구 비용을 낮춰 소외 인구를 위한 질환 연구를 확장하는 내용을 포함할 것.
writing.answer: By lowering pharmaceutical research costs, AI has the power to democratize drug development and expand medical attention to diseases affecting underserved populations.
writing.explanation_ko: AI의 비용 절감(lowering costs) + 민주화 역량(democratize) + 소외 인구 질환으로 확장(expand to underserved populations)의 세 요소를 포함한 한 문장.
